# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release and the current `main` branch receive security fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Contact Andy directly at andy at neillans dot co dot uk. Please do not open a public issue. Reports
are checked against known and in-progress fixes, and any remediation is logged and tracked.

We do not offer a bounty programme.

Dependabot runs on this repository, and dependencies are updated routinely.
